notes: v0.19.5: Extended Avatar Favorites can now be saved directly from any normal VRChat favorite avatar card using a Save button and native category chooser; no avatar ID copying or intermediate screen is required. Saved avatars display a Saved state and may be moved between local categories without duplicate rows. Extended Favorites now offers + From favorites as the primary import method; manual avatar link/ID entry remains available as an advanced option. Existing VRC+ entitlement checks, account-scoped SQLite data and non-server favorite behavior remain unchanged. The remaining visible Mini-VRCX references in Quest tools, group tools and pinned group help text have been replaced with Companion/Quest terminology, while legacy internal database/preferences keys are preserved. Quest folder-first tracking and disabled Quest floater, phone Shizuku and floater, staff authorization, Relay and GM4/GM1 remain unchanged. No Main Launcher or Relay deployments.
